sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades: the official PS5 list on Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/). PSN counts and targets: PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). Every guide is our own words, written from the official description only, and not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands and activities, then collectibles and counts, so nothing is left for a second playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story, so it pops as you play — no preparation needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapters pop in order as you play the story — keep going and this one comes on its own.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as every chapter trophy: play the story through and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Play the story through; the chapter trophies cannot be missed, they pop when each chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale — keep playing the story and it pops.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Do the stranger strands, activities and collectibles first: the official list does not say whether side content stays open after the finale, so treat the final mission as the point of no return and clear everything else before it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — it pops when the mission is done, so just play it when it appears.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission — play it when it appears and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission — it pops when the mission is done.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission — play it when it appears and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — it pops when the mission is done.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — it pops when the mission is done.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and every counted challenge. Use the checklist to see what is left — the last few percent are almost always collectibles or a counted grind.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts count across the whole game, so drive fast, catch air and land clean whenever you travel — the counter climbs in the background. PSN tracks the count to 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample all 9 activity types — one try each is enough, you do not need to win or finish any of them. Work through them early so you know which ones you enjoy.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold every challenge — practice one range at a time and use the range's own scoring feedback. The count PSN tracks is 42.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PSNProfiles — PSN target: 42 Shooting Range challenges
Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Win one drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations. Learn each course once, then race it — winning is what counts, not the time.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PSNProfiles — PSN target: 14 Top Fun locations
Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same race do not count, so keep entering new ones — a win in a race you have already won adds nothing.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal and beat him — fishing is one of the activities, so warm up on ordinary fishing first to learn how it plays.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Finish any one arcade game to the end — pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's stranger strand to its last mission. Do stranger strands before the final story mission, in case a strand locks after the story ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's stranger strand to its last mission, before the final story mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger strand to its last mission, before the final story mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Finish 8 full stranger strands — a strand counts when its final mission is done. There are more than 8 strangers, so pick the strands you enjoy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger strand to its last mission, before the final story mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger strand to its last mission, before the final story mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditate at all 18 spots. Clear a region's spots as you pass through it so you do not have to backtrack at the end.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand — the official description does not name the animal or the place, so take the hunt when Bret offers it and follow the in-game markers.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Finish 3 full card sets. Cards are a collectible — pick up every card you see and track which sets are closest in the checklist.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: PSNProfiles — PSN target: 3 Collectible Card sets
Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The count is locations, not uses — keep moving to new spots instead of repeating the same one.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Finish 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges tick over during normal play — check the challenges menu to see which ones are closest to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Set it up deliberately: bring your partner, raise heat to 4 stars away from mission pressure, then break line of sight and hide until it clears. If your partner leaves or you get busted, set it up again.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route of three close shops first, then run it in one go — do not let the wanted level drop between shops and do not get caught.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you see — a new model counts when you first get in. Check the vehicles menu for what is still missing.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait until at least 5 enemies are close together, thin the group first if you must, then trigger Combat Focus and drop all 5 before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PSNProfiles — PSN target: 5 enemies in one Combat Focus
Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — steal a plane and take off without following the normal departure. Airport security will react, so be ready to fly the moment you are aboard.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke, not a target — expect a fight built around the Rhino tanks, and use heavy weapons and cover.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go at a quiet hour, move slowly, and avoid cameras and staff sightlines — being spotted once fails the attempt, so leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults are the big robberies — bring your partner and a getaway plan, and escape cleanly each time for it to count.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run set routes — watch one, strike when it is away from police, then break away fast.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas. The map fills in as you travel — drive every road and check the map for dark patches.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked once you find them — work gang by gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. It reads like a quiet story moment — look for a bar or a scenic spot on Ocean Beach and take the prompt when it appears.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Break out of a vehicle showroom by smashing through it, in the classic style the description hints at. When a showroom scene gives you the chance, drive out through the glass, not the door.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end. Go to the alley, start a game and finish it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A partnership moment — play the story with your partner and look for a scene where the partnership itself is the point. The official description names no place, so this one pops from a story beat, not a grind.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. Choices happen across the story and side content, so keep choosing; the count climbs as you play.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed on a second try — fail something once, then succeed at the same thing on the next attempt. The description suggests a retry, so this pops from a failed-then-passed moment.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange. Strange events happen in the world — explore odd places and follow anything out of the ordinary. The official description names no place, so this is one to stumble on.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — drive past on a bike or in a car and hit with a melee weapon. Line up a slow target and swing as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — launder them steadily instead of holding them.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It counts across every shop, so buy the gear, clothes and upgrades you want and the total adds up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought with cash — save for them as you earn, and buy each one when it is offered.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register each new vehicle you find — ten different registrations is the target.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game
